skills.name: Lunatic - Copy
lines: Activate Lunatic status Copy on user (3 turns)
* Copy: Skills execute twice.
** Copy has 0 MP cost and no AF gain.
** Copy increases Combo multiplier in AF normally.
** Copy counts as another move for move-based buffs.
** Copy animation happens after the original skill use and plays out fully.
** Copy will move on to the next enemy if the original target dies from the first attack.
* Replaces the basic attack until used (1 activation)

abilities.name: Critical Guard
lines: User has a chance equal to their physical critical rate to reduce own damage taken by a % determined by their LCK
* Damage Reduction: (LCK ÷ 500) × 75%, maximum 75% (500 LCK)
** Multiplicative with all other types of damage modification
** Applies against physical, magic, and fixed damage attacks (including self-damage)
** Applies against enemy end-of-turn attacks
* Mid-battle changes to critical rate and LCK are also used

* Apply Singular Focus on user (3 turn) and Stack 1 Vulnus Gemma
** Vulnus Gemma Stack: END, SPR and LUK +5 and Critical Rate +5% and Reduce Damage Recived by 1% per stack (Max Stack 30)

* For ally to the left of user: Apply Mental Focus and Singular Focus (3 turns)
* When used durring Stellar Burst: Skill multiplier +1400% (Multiplier x15) and Activate Lunatic status Copy on user (3 turns)
** Perform Curis Sanatio in link
